name: Excalidraw
what: Hand-drawn diagrams and animated explainers rendered inline in the chat from a JSON array of elements: shapes, labels, bound arrows, draw-on streaming and camera moves. No file, link or image comes back.
install: Attach the Excalidraw connector in the host's connector settings.
firstCall: read_me, once in a conversation, before the first create_view
evidenceNote: Both tool schemas read. One free call made: read_me, which returned the element format, the palette, the camera rules and examples, with no sign-in step. create_view was not called, so no diagram was rendered. No export path is documented. No pricing field exists in the schemas.
